catalogueSections.heading: Overview
catalogueSections.markdown:

Backend development is my main focus, but I learn the technologies each project requires rather than limiting myself to a single stack.

catalogueSections.markdown:
- JavaScript

- Java
- Python
- PHP

- C

catalogueSections.heading: Applied in projects
catalogueSections.markdown:
TypeScript and JavaScript connect public websites, dashboards and APIs. Python supports automation and data/ML tooling, Go appears in the FYP telemetry/API backend, and R supports academic analysis. Java, C++ and Rust appear in simulations and data-structure/control work.

- **Agent Property — Bilingual Property Website and CMS:** A bilingual property-discovery website that combines CMS-managed listings, housing-scheme information and educational content with direct WhatsApp enquiries.

Public website: [MyRumawip](https://myrumawip.com/).
- **MyReport — WhatsApp Customer Follow-up and Reporting Workspace:** A customer-management workspace that organizes WhatsApp conversations, confirmed customer requirements, eligibility records and follow-up actions, with human-reviewed AI assistance.

**Access:** Hosted privately via Tailscale; not publicly accessible.
- **FYP — Hybrid Anomaly Detection for Microservice Observability:** A telemetry-based anomaly-detection system that combines OpenTelemetry ingestion, Redis streaming, machine-learning inference and a live observability dashboard, evaluated using telemetry from an instrumented CMS application.
- **DTM — Coupon Data Preparation and Exploratory Analysis:** An R data-preparation study that introduces controlled data-quality problems into an in-vehicle coupon dataset, cleans it and compares exploratory views before and after preprocessing.
- **PFDA — Credit-Risk Data Analysis:** An R-based group study of credit-risk data, combining cleaning, exploratory analysis, statistical tests and predictive experiments.
- **Concurrent Programming — Airport Simulation:** A Java airport simulation modeling aircraft activity and access to shared runway, gate and refueling resources.
- **Data Structures — E-commerce Analytics and Tournament Management:** A two-part C++ assignment applying custom data structures to transaction/review analysis and tournament, spectator and result-management simulations.
- **RTS — Ground and Onboard Control Simulation:** A Rust real-time-systems assignment modeling communication between a Ground Control Station (GCS) and an Onboard Control System (OCS), with timed commands, telemetry and fault handling.

catalogueSections.heading: Engineering workflow
catalogueSections.markdown: Start from the data model and interface contract. Use typed records for application boundaries, keep parsing/validation explicit, and choose concurrency or data structures according to the problem.

catalogueSections.heading: Technical decisions
catalogueSections.markdown: TypeScript adds useful checks around API and UI data. SQL describes relational operations. Academic Java/C++ projects expose synchronization, ownership and algorithm mechanics rather than hiding them behind framework code.

catalogueSections.markdown: The completed About profile identifies **User empathy and Adaptability** as strengths. Frontend work at LYJ Events & Marketing includes stakeholder collaboration, QA feedback and evolving requirements. DWMLight's confirmed contribution focuses on CMS/backend and deployment.

catalogueSections.markdown:
Fedora Dotfiles combines Stow, KDE/Hyprland, Quickshell/QML and a native PyQt6 sharing chooser. Client work includes server/deployment responsibilities, and FYP provides shell-driven load/chaos tooling.

- **Fedora Dotfiles — Customized Wayland Desktop Environment:** A personalized Fedora desktop/development environment combining KDE Plasma and Hyprland sessions with a custom shell, login appearance, sharing picker and reusable configuration management.
- **Agent Property — Bilingual Property Website and CMS:** A bilingual property-discovery website that combines CMS-managed listings, housing-scheme information and educational content with direct WhatsApp enquiries.

Public website: [MyRumawip](https://myrumawip.com/).
- **DWMLight / ANVA CMS — Multilingual Product Website and Custom CMS:** A multilingual product and company website backed by a custom content-management API, including localized content, product media and downloadable catalogues.

Public website: [DWMLight](https://dwmlight.com/en).
- **FYP — Hybrid Anomaly Detection for Microservice Observability:** A telemetry-based anomaly-detection system that combines OpenTelemetry ingestion, Redis streaming, machine-learning inference and a live observability dashboard, evaluated using telemetry from an instrumented CMS application.

catalogueSections.heading: Engineering workflow
catalogueSections.markdown: Version configuration, separate session/service responsibilities, preserve upstream protocols and clean up asynchronous previews or processes when they stop being useful.

catalogueSections.heading: Technical decisions
catalogueSections.markdown: The sharing chooser customizes selection UI while the existing portal/PipeWire services retain permission and sharing responsibilities. Desktop customization integrates upstream tools rather than reimplementing Linux graphics.

catalogueSections.heading: Collaboration and delivery
catalogueSections.markdown: The completed About profile identifies **User empathy and Adaptability** as strengths. Frontend work at LYJ Events & Marketing includes stakeholder collaboration, QA feedback and evolving requirements. DWMLight's confirmed contribution focuses on CMS/backend and deployment.

catalogueSections.heading: Learning and scope
catalogueSections.markdown: About confirms an interest in installing/customizing distributions including Arch and Mint. Fedora has a dedicated catalogue project; the other named distributions are profile-backed, without invented clean-machine benchmarks.
